Claire (Monarch Ops): Hi — procurement just flagged that we can't pay without a formal PO on file. They asked for a proforma invoice and vendor registration details (legal name, EIN, remittance address). Can someone from billing confirm what we can send today?

Jia (Support): Sorry about the friction, Claire. We can generate a proforma right away. Can you confirm the exact billing entity name and the email for AP? Also let us know if VAT/tax is applicable.

Claire (Monarch Ops): AP email is ap@monarchhealth.com. This is a US entity but procurement also asked for Redwood's VAT/Tax ID for their vendor portal. They want the PO before they release the funds — deadline EOM.

Omar (AE): I'm on it. Quick confirmation: committed plan is Reserved Capacity — $24,000/year (annual invoice). I'll attach a proforma with the line items and total.

billing-bot: Proforma generated by billing system: https://redwood.internal/proforma/PR-2025-0893 (access limited) :paperclip:

Jia (Support): Uploaded a short packet for procurement. Claire, please share any vendor form fields they require (vendor code, remit to, tax classification). If they need W-9 we can provide that.

Claire (Monarch Ops): They asked for: legal name, DBA, EIN, W-9, remittance address, and banking details for ACH setup (or vendor portal). They also want Redwood's vendor code if you have one.

Omar (AE): Legal name: "Redwood Inference, Inc."
EIN: 12-3456789
Remit address: 720 Market St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94102
Payment terms: Net 30.
(Will confirm bank details with Finance — we share those via secure portal only.)

Jia (Support): Copying the snippet below for procurement — feel free to paste into their vendor portal:
```
Vendor name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
DBA: Redwood
EIN: 12-3456789
Remit to: Redwood Inference, Inc., 720 Market St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94102
Invoice email: billing@redwood.ai
Payment terms: Net 30
```

Sara (AcctPay): Hi all — FYI we can provide W-9 and payment instructions. We do not share full bank account details in public Slack — please ask procurement to send an encrypted request to billing@redwood.ai or use our vendor portal. Once we receive their vendor registration and PO number, we'll finalize the invoice and send a Payee Advice.

Claire (Monarch Ops): Procurement insists on a vendor onboarding packet before they issue the PO. They will only create the PO once W-9 and the proforma are uploaded to their portal. Can you confirm someone will upload or provide documents in a way they accept?

Omar (AE): I'll escalate to Sales Ops/legal to produce the W-9 and the secure upload link. @Sara can you confirm an ETA?

Sara (AcctPay): I can prepare the W-9 and secure link today. ETA: 3pm PT. Once they upload, procurement said they can issue PO within 48 hours.

Claire (Monarch Ops): Perfect — procurement will aim to issue PO by EOD Wednesday after they receive the W-9 + proforma. We'll post the PO# here when it's issued.

Jia (Support): Great — I'll mark this thread as blocked on "PO issued" and follow up after 3pm. If procurement runs into validation errors on the vendor portal, please paste the portal validation message here and we'll troubleshoot. :thumbsup:

Omar (AE): Thanks — I'll send a summary email to ap@monarchhealth.com with the proforma link and instructions for secure upload.

Claire (Monarch Ops): Received. Thanks everyone!
